# AI Search Patch Writer

AI Search Patch Writer is a static tool that turns weak SaaS/product page copy
into a concrete AI-search patch pack.

Primary URL:
https://speedranger.github.io/ai-search-patch-writer/

Primary job:
Paste public product-page copy and generate comparison copy, buyer-fit framing,
FAQ, JSON-LD, crawlability notes, proof objects, and a public-safe paid request
packet.

Audience:
SaaS founders, devtool makers, and operators who want their product pages to be
clearer to buyers, search engines, and AI answer systems.

Boundaries:
The tool does not guarantee rankings, citations, Product Hunt placement, or
revenue. It does not require private data. Public requests must contain only
public URLs and public page copy.
